title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements: Holding Several Deals
content:
**Rule.** Under the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements** a customer may hold any number of purchase deals over time, and deals of different deal types are held side by side. Each deal stands on its own for deposits, charges, payments and balance. No overall limit applies to the number of deals a customer may hold. How many deals one customer may have open in reserved status at the same time is governed by the reservation rule of each deal type, which counts that customer's reserved deals of the requested deal type against the deal type's figure.

## What "stands on its own" means

| Item | Kept per deal |
|---|---|
| Deposits received and held | yes, each deal holds its own deposits |
| Charges posted (price, fees, taxes) | yes |
| Payments and credits applied | yes |
| Balance due | yes, one balance per deal |

## Basis questions
- *May a customer who already holds a delivered New Vehicle Retail Purchase open a Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase?* Yes. Deals of different deal types are held side by side, and the number of deals a customer may hold over time is not limited.
- *Does a payment made on one deal reduce the balance of another deal of the same customer?* No. Each deal stands on its own for payments and balance.
